scope: Practice measurements for the gang-hunter and owned live-walker-iron kit variants against ganker-live/ganker-dds; each run has two independent one-versus-three meetings. No current-source or live qualification.

setFamilies.r5/r6: Game-tick waits; freeze casting retains the configured armour.
setFamilies.r7: Freeze casting removes the torso by default.
setFamilies.r8: Freeze casting removes the torso and confirms the hold two ticks after the cast.

conditions.timing: elapsedMs is bench wall time; RESULT ticks is meeting game ticks; ledgerTicks includes each account's charged ticks.

selection: All 68 source records using game-tick waits. The 96 wall-clock-wait records are excluded because worker speed changes their timeout behavior.
